title: Pro Football GM 2026 - AI helped me do a thing
author: PrinceofJive
selftext:
So, I've been playing football video games for 40+ years and slowly watched a certain one degrade into a trash heap and ruin my favorite mode - Franchise. This inspired me to see if I could make a Franchise Mode game that would keep me interested longer than a couple of seasons and be deep enough for the stat-heads. 

It started out as a python project and then I wanted a better UI so it's got a Godot "skin" over the Python engine. 

Some features that I'm pretty proud of: 

You can pre-sim up to 30 years to build a league history with records and Hall of Famers.

Retired players can fill the coaching ranks if they have high enough awareness at their position. 

You can either quick sim, watch a quick gamecast like you would on a phone or an on-field full game simulation where players run real plays.

If you use the field sim, you can watch multiple games at once like a certain PPV service on a mosaic along with a (work in progress on the trigger) TheZone feature that will bounce around the games automatically when a drive gets close to scoring territory. 

The steam page is in the waiting period but if you want to try it out I have a 1 season demo up on itch here: https://scopecreepinteractive.itch.io/pro-football-gm-2026

"Studio" (it's just me and cursor) name is Scope Creep Interactive which I'm sure anyone working on building a game can identify with 😂😂😂

Thanks for looking. I hope you enjoy!
